data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'bza' which means 'to bring good news'. In Islamic tradition, the name Bazegha symbolizes the joy and happiness that comes from delivering good news and spreading positivity. The name Bazegha carries the meaning “Giver of Good News” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bazegha usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
